notes.title: New Multiplayer Maps!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Content Update, This Friday! 04/07/2025.[/b] 

What's coming? 
[b]NEW MULTIPLAYER MAPS.[/b] 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548057/2ef4d29550553225778f5cdf0d0a5b745904d71d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]The Outer Earth Space Race.[/b][/p][p]The longest of all the space race maps. Featuring some old favorites such as.. [/p][list][*][p]The Invisible Path (the same but different),[/p][/*][*][p]Choose no. 3 (the same but different),[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548057/c94c6927c8fae5a6366f97f3d424cac8040313d5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The Platform.[/b][/p][p]One platform moving through space. 
The rings of the platform will change colour.
Move to that colour or be launched into space!
Push your opponents to their deaths to win. 
Last man standing! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45548057/ee96fb3e824c741dc714f95298066d939a6391de.jpg"][/img][/p][p]

[b]CHANGES.[/b] [/p][olist][*][p]Speedboosts now respawn.,[/p][/*][*][p]Freezewall design has changed to make it look better.,[/p][/*][*][p]The rotating tools on the Lunar Base Race have been balanced to not rotate as often.,[/p][/*][*][p]Extra Freezewalls added to the Lunar Base Race to make it more difficult for the leader to keep their lead.,[/p][/*][*][p]Space Race has been renamed to Multiplayer on the main menu because people were getting confused lol[/p][/*][/olist]
